channel.title: Jacob's Daily Digest
channel.description: A personal daily news digest: Chiefs, Nebraska football, AI and agent tooling, running, and San Francisco.

item.title: 'Angry' Rhule fires OC Holgorsen amid Nebraska's 4-game skid
item.description: Matt Rhule fired offensive coordinator Dana Holgorsen after Nebraska's fourth straight loss, 24-13 at Illinois. Pressure and buyout talk are mounting in Lincoln.

item.title: Illinois tops Nebraska 24-13 to secure bowl eligibility
item.description: The Huskers dropped their fourth straight in Champaign; Owen Chambliss left the game with an injury.

item.title: Chiefs rule out three players for Sunday's game against Jets
item.description: CB Mansoor Delane (shoulder) and DTs Peter Woods (neck) and Omarr Norman-Lott (knee) are out for Week 9 vs. the Jets; a top special teamer is questionable.

item.title: Expert breaks down Chiefs' pursuit of WRs ahead of NFL trade deadline
item.description: KC is reportedly active in the receiver market with the trade deadline looming after Week 9.

item.title: Kansas City Chiefs elevate DL for Week 9 matchup vs. New York Jets
item.description: Practice-squad defensive line help called up for Sunday with three linemen sidelined.

item.title: This week in Claude Code, Codex and Gemini CLI (week of November 8, 2026)
item.description: Weekly roundup of what shipped across the big three coding-agent CLIs.

item.title: Weekly AI Dev News Digest: November 1 - November 6, 2026
item.description: 348 new MCP tools added this week; standouts include MCPJungle for connecting MCP servers and Floorplan, which maps an app after an agent writes it.

item.title: Google ADK 2.14.0 Graduates Core Modules, Adds Teams Runner
item.description: Google's Agent Development Kit release graduates core modules and adds a Teams runner.

item.title: SF got $7M to expand its innovation team. Lurie just fired most of it
item.description: Despite a $7M Bloomberg grant to grow the civic innovation office, the mayor cut most of its staff.

item.title: Mayor Daniel Lurie gains power - and loses excuses
item.description: Mission Local on what this week's election results mean for Lurie's leverage at City Hall.

item.title: Did the Bay Area just save its transit system from the brink of certain death?
item.description: The Guardian on the funding measure that may have pulled BART and Muni back from the fiscal cliff.

item.title: 2026 NYC Marathon becomes the first marathon ever to exceed 60,000 finishers
item.description: New York set the all-time finisher record for any marathon.

item.title: Almgren wins on marathon debut, Chepkirui regains title in New York
item.description: Andreas Almgren won the NYC Marathon in his debut at the distance; Chepkirui took the women's race. Relevant context with your Dec 12 sub-3 attempt five weeks out.
